facts.text: SUNY Oswego guarantees an alumni mentor through the Alumni-Sharing-Knowledge Program for every student who desires one.

sources.title: Oswego Guarantee
sources.quote: We guarantee an alumni mentor for every student who desires one.

facts.text: Full-time undergraduate students are guaranteed the availability of on-campus housing on the Oswego campus until graduation.

sources.title: Oswego Guarantee
sources.quote: We guarantee the availability of on-campus housing on the Oswego campus for all full-time undergraduate students until they graduate.
